title: Request attachment approval
summary: Send one produced file for human approval as an attachment.
purpose: Send one produced file for human approval as an attachment.
request: POST `multipart/form-data` to {{route:attachments.upload_request}} with `file` and JSON `meta` containing the filename and note. See `attachments/request_rules` for limits.
response: The response is immediately `pending`. Continue working while approval is pending.
errors: See `attachments/request_rules` for size, extension, target, and limit errors.
